report:
Reviewed the complete recording claim, both ordinary implementation files (main.rs and review.rs) and all eight ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A evidence exists. Captured fixture helpers and all four explicitly referenced format/freshness/association/decision claims.

The CLI record branch requires anchor and report-file arguments, deserializes the strict ValidationOutput and calls the shared record API. record rejects invalid output before publication, rebuilds the current valid inventory, requires the requested anchor to exist, locates its safe validation directory and locks the validations directory. read_summary checks a real directory, matching anchor ID and supported schema/policy. Recording requires an unfinished review: a recorded timestamp or existing output rejects it. Missing input or summary is an error. It compares stored input against the freshly built inventory through input_errors, including association metadata and initial fragments plus selector-resolved additional reads. Changed context produces an error requiring a fresh start, never replacement of reviewed text.

On success only output.json and summary.json are written; input.json is read but never rewritten. output_error enforces valid nonblank supplied fields, while semantic report completeness is the reviewer's responsibility under the linked output claim. Concrete requested edits are allowed to be saved, but acceptable/validate reject them for gate success. A successful record therefore means completed reporting, not necessarily acceptance.

Publication uses an exclusive OS lock on the existing validations-directory inode for start/capture/record and load_saved readers. start removes the old anchor directory before publishing fresh input/summary. write_json uses a unique temporary sibling and rename for each file; record writes output first and only then sets completion time. load_saved treats an output as complete only when summary completion metadata exists, so a process interrupted before the final summary write cannot approve a partial result. Locking prevents cooperative readers from observing an interleaving of review file operations, and start's removal prevents files from an older attempt standing in for the new one. The claim does not establish a transaction over arbitrary concurrent edits to external source files; later source changes are handled by freshness validation.

Tests: cli_start_and_record_roundtrip_exact_saved_input invokes real CLI start with multiline instructions, verifies printed/saved inputs match, records a report file, checks successful gate and rejects an incomplete record command. start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required checks active/restarted status, absence of old output, captured-read noncompletion, byte-identical input across record, populated recording time and refusal to record/read after completion. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects absent active review, blank output fields and changed initial implementation source, preserves saved input bytes, then verifies exact storage of an edit-requesting report while the gate stays failing.

record_rejects_invalid_active_identity_and_changed_associations exercises unknown anchor, missing input, summary identity, schema and policy mismatches, and a cfg metadata change with identical test text. Every case must reject without output or recording time and remain invalid. disappeared_or_invalidated_additional_fragments_reject_recording removes an additional WholeFile dependency or makes a captured range out of bounds, checking named errors, absent output and unchanged input. incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate covers output before completion metadata, missing completed output and malformed partial output; each is rejected by the gate.

restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged uses two accepted anchors and checks all three files of the untouched anchor byte-for-byte across restart/record of the other. checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records additionally proves recording a current anchor does not prune or modify an obsolete directory, which continues to fail validation until separately reconciled. These are direct assertions over record lifecycle and bytes, not helper names. Fixture helpers create real isolated Cargo/model/claim inputs and invoke production APIs/binary.

All specified failure classes, stored-input preservation, completion semantics, other-anchor isolation and incomplete-publication rejection are accounted for by source and tests. No source changes or unresolved defect were found. This pass ran review start/read/record and source inspection only; centrally run behavioral suites were not repeated or claimed as independent execution. Dependency capture is complete. No requested edits.
